description: This script connects to a MongoDB database, lists all collections, and displays the first few documents from each collection for inspection. It uses mongoose for database interaction and includes functions for masking URIs and extracting database names. The script is intended for development or debugging purposes to explore database contents.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Prints a formatted section header to the console.

methods.name: maskMongoUri
methods.description: Masks sensitive credentials in a MongoDB URI for safe logging.

methods.name: dbNameFromUriPath
methods.description: Extracts the database name from a MongoDB URI's path component.

methods.name: fetchFirstNFromCollection
methods.description: Fetches the first N documents from a specified collection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that performs the database connection, collection listing, and data preview.
